help:
usage: gnd export pyrel [-h] --out OUT
                        [--duckdb-path DUCKDB_PATH | --connection CONNECTION]
                        [--rules {duckdb,lqp}]
                        model

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             new Python program path
  --duckdb-path DUCKDB_PATH
  --connection CONNECTION
                        reserved named Snowflake connection
  --rules {duckdb,lqp}  write the model's rules as a readable PyRel program of
                        requirements instead of the checker: 'lqp' enforces
                        them with require on a RelationalAI engine; 'duckdb'
                        checks the same requirements locally through their
                        violation queries
